body:
## What it does

A business-side counterpart for people whose instincts are engineering-shaped. It takes the positioning and go-to-market questions you are stuck on, reasons through them using the partial evidence actually in front of you, and returns a defensible call rather than a request for more research. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @thesmitpatel shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
